decision.reasoning_trace: The consideration set represents a mix of ultra-portable/waterproof (Altec Lansing), rugged outdoor (DOSS), novelty/giftable (My Audio Pet), utility/emergency (KAYINUO), and high-end home audio (Edifier) products. I decided on the Altec Lansing Mini H2O because it offers a proven track record with over 15,000 reviews and a high rating of 4.4. It is IP67 certified and floats, making it the most versatile and reliable choice for a portable Bluetooth speaker at a very reasonable price point. While the Edifier offers superior sound, it is a significant investment for a different use case. The Altec Lansing strikes the best balance of value, portability, and durability.
